column1: # Reserved stack identities, one row per GitHub Environment.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# All three environments are stacks on ONE host, and their real configuration
# lives in GitHub Environment variables, which are not reviewable in a PR and
# not diffable. `staging` shipped pointing at dev's deploy directory, dev's
# compose project and dev's ports; nothing anywhere said that was wrong.
# This file is the reviewable half of that configuration: it declares what each
# environment is allowed to own. preflight-isolation.sh cross-checks the values
# CD actually resolved against these rows and fails the deploy when an
# environment resolves to a value RESERVED BY A DIFFERENT ROW — which it can
# detect with nothing running at all, unlike the live container/port checks.
# It is an ASSERTION, not a source of truth. Changing a port here does not
# change a deploy; change the GitHub Environment variable and this row together,
# in the same change, or the next deploy fails loudly (which is the point).
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   environment  deploy_dir  compose_project  name_prefix  ports (comma-separated)
# An environment with no row here is not blocked — the guard warns and falls
# back to the live checks only.
environment
dev
staging
production
